Cigars & the ritual around them

PM issuePrices checked Tue Oct 20, 2026 (evening scan)

Boxes worth laying down, honest-value bundles, and well-made tools. Every comparison is against observed street price—not an ornamental MSRP.

Availability note. Ten desk entries were price-checked for this issue — all ten verified live Tuesday evening, October 20, 2026 (evening scan) across JR Cigar, Thompson Cigar, CigarBid, Cigars.com, Famous Smoke, and Fox Cigar, plus named street-reference sources; all 10 are unique listings. Discounts use live street prices only. One entry is a CigarBid live auction — the price shown is the bid-to-win total including first-unit shipping at check time, not a fixed price, and the bid may rise before the close time shown on the card. Five entries ship without a confirmed listing photo: four Thompson Cigar listings whose pages exposed only placeholder or mismatched imagery tonight, and the CigarBid lot, whose imagery is demonstration-only. Stock, sale windows, auction bids, shipping, and checkout totals may change after the check.

Affiliate disclosure. The Ledger may earn a commission from qualifying purchases through tagged eBay and Amazon links, at no extra cost to the buyer. Other merchant links remain plain.

Collectible ≠ guaranteed return

The investment desk is an asking-price snapshot, not a resale forecast. Each listing names its comparison source and shows condition and completeness where the scan confirmed them.

Price integrityThe investment desk names its comparison basis on every card — this issue’s one investment reference, named in full: the Audemars Piguet Royal Oak 15510ST.OO.1320ST.07 (Sarasota Watch Company — pre-owned, full set with original box and papers; the street comp is the live Chrono24 professional-dealer median of $52,825 across 68 dealer listings for the exact reference, with the dealer’s own Chrono24 listing excluded from that median). Compare condition, seller type, completeness, shipping, and import costs before treating any asking-price gap as a deal.
LiquidityEstimate how broad the resale market is and how quickly similar pieces actually move.
CompletenessBox, papers, original parts and service records can matter disproportionately.
Ownership dragBuyer premium, tax, servicing, insurance and selling fees belong in the thesis.

Market data, not financial advice. No appreciation claims. Watches are illiquid collectibles; values can fall, provenance can be wrong, and servicing can erase an apparent discount.

Verify before buying

Liquidity, defined. Each watch carries the Ledger's liquidity read — High: deep resale market, typically sells in days at market price; Good: active market, typically sells in weeks at a fair price; Thin: narrow buyer pool, longer to sell. It's an editorial assessment from comparable listings, price band, and condition — a guide to how fast you could get out, not a resale guarantee.
